## AuthDomainError class

Authentication Domain Error Class

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class AuthDomainError extends AuthError 
```
**Extends:** [AuthError](./auth-errors.autherror.md)

## Remarks

Represents expected business logic errors that occur during normal authentication operations. These errors are user-facing and typically result from invalid user input or business rules.

Domain errors use 'warn' log level as they are expected and don't indicate system problems.

## Example


```typescript
// User tries to register with existing email
throw new AuthDomainError(AuthDomainErrorCodes.AUTH_USED_EMAIL);

// User provides wrong password
throw new AuthDomainError(AuthDomainErrorCodes.INCORRECT_CREDENTIALS);
```
